arms.concurrent: As gdm_live, but dispatched by an episode-scoped background dispatcher in parallel with planner inference.
arms.gdm_live: Hidden isolated cover; sleep until a gap drawn from the pool has elapsed since the triggering call's end, then call; server holds the response to a duration drawn from the destination pool.
arms.shadow: Hidden isolated shadow episode of the same model on a decoy ticket whose action is drawn uniformly from all six actions independently of the real label; with probability .5 the shadow starts first (real get_ticket held U(0.2,1.5) s), otherwise it starts U(0.2,1.5) s after the real ticket returns; shares the seven MCP sessions.
arms.unmatched: Hidden isolated cover dispatched immediately after the triggering tool response (M3 schedule).

attacks.configuration: Original M3 byte153 and S11 timing49/context34 feature definitions; LR C=1/max_iter=3000/random102, RF300/n_jobs2/random102. Call detectors balanced classes, validation F1 then precision then LR then higher threshold; thresholds .05:.05:.95. GMM2 n_init5/log10 gaps, fit unlabelled condition TRAIN only. First event has no preceding gap and GMM leaves it unstripped as a heuristic, not a known honest role. Joint decoder evaluates all 0/1/2 removals with prior [.02,.49,.49], LR/RF context probabilities, lambda[0,.5,1,2,4] or marginal; selected on validation task accuracy. Original bounded-removal decoder is retained in shadow and complemented by chain separation. Gap-rule candidates .025/.05/.10/.20/.35/.50/1 seconds compete with the basic detector; F1/precision ties prefer LR, gap rule, RF, then higher threshold.
attacks.fitting: Train per arm; validate for attack/threshold selection; ties to declared order with size first. No test-driven attack selection. Fitted conditional bootstrap intervals do not include model/refitting/selection uncertainty. Old M3/S11 fixture outcomes have already been seen; this is a new timing-layer collection on reused fixtures, not an untouched-workload confirmation.
attacks.shadow_specific: Beam-64 causal two-chain partition with no within-chain call overlap; transition log-gap model fitted on none TRAIN, no true role in inference. Clean-chain task classifier plus LR real-chain selector fitted on labelled shadow TRAIN. Chronological first chain is not assumed real; validation-selected as one candidate.

best_attack.adaptive_best: validation-selected among size_only then timing then shadow_specific; ties to size_only
best_attack.size_only_best: validation-selected among size_only; ties to earlier entry

collection.arm_order: All none episodes first. Then rotate unmatched,gdm_live,concurrent,shadow by the original unit list index; one model at a time, workers=1.
collection.capture_gate: All relay ingress TLS record types, lengths and counts must match independent Npcap TCP reassembly; report median/p99 timing error. Failed capture or unknown request stops collection, with no silent replacement.
collection.phase_gates: Push frozen plan/code before none; verify completed none and its capture; extract TRAIN-only pools with frozen script, hash and push/read back before cover.
collection.readiness: development units only; excluded from all denominators
collection.same_connection_calls: Serialized by service-specific locks. Seven MCP sessions are shared and reused; different destinations and planner inference remain concurrent. This restriction defines unambiguous TLS-record call windows and does not test unrestricted within-destination multiplexing.
collection.unknown_policy: as M3: journal before dispatch, no retry, abort collection for audit

implementation_adjustments: Service-specific locking prevents overlapping same-TLS-connection call windows while retaining inter-service and inference concurrency.
The shadow-first control removes the known-honest first-call prior in that arm.
Server hold starts when the request body is received; measured client/record duration includes transport and scheduling overhead, so target draws need not equal achieved durations.
Parallel shadow GPU contention is part of this arm; two ordinary inference slots and no concurrent episodes. Model-dependent path changes are outcomes, not discarded samples.

interpretation_rules.gdm_live_vs_counterfactual: Report agreement or disagreement with S11 explicitly; do not pool live and counterfactual results.
interpretation_rules.replication_fail: If R fails, revise the main-text removal claim.
interpretation_rules.shadow_pass: If E passes in both models and C shows decreased size-only task accuracy: report equivalence of tested timing-suite increment within the margin and the remaining task recognition, role performance, and token/latency/byte cost. Do not call all cover indistinguishable.
interpretation_rules.shadow_separable: P marks shadow separable: report the separating attack and signal.

observer: Destination, bidirectional encrypted call bytes and relay-record completion timing; evaluator-supplied episode/call windows and labelled TRAIN calls. Same-connection windows serialized. First ticket known honest only in none/unmatched/gdm_live/concurrent; in shadow the first call role is UNKNOWN. No request identifiers, private role, operation, object, state, model link or token counts enter attack features.
pools: Extracted by a frozen script from the none arm TRAIN split at the relay-record layer: non-first honest gaps; honest durations per destination (fallback to all destinations below 20 samples). Hashed and pushed before any cover arm is collected.
population: Same 300 units per model as the M3 cohort plan (120/60/120 split, six balanced actions, identical task ids and fixtures). Fixture holdout, not template or deployment transfer.

power_note.method: Exact planning-probability sum under assumed multinomial; paired t-TOST rejection rule
power_note.note: Planning distribution, not empirical power. Fixed 3000-episode budget retained; unresolved equivalence is an allowed outcome.

publication: Only reviewed synthetic, payload-free features/predictions, JSON pools, plans, code and hashes. Packet captures, raw transcripts, TLS keys and model weights stay private. New public results require current-byte scope review.

questions.Q1: Under TLS-record-level timestamps, does label-free removal still strip unmatched executed cover?
questions.Q2: Does live timing-matched dispatch (sequential and concurrent) agree with the receipt-level counterfactual of Supplement S10/S11?
questions.Q3: Does planner-generated cover remove an accuracy advantage of this timing attack suite over validation-selected size-only attacks, within +/-10 points? Also report true/shadow role discrimination and chain candidate ambiguity.

shadow_controls.action_sampling: All six classes, independently of the real class, including same-class tickets.
shadow_controls.interpretation: Random order does not prove role indistinguishability. Recovering two candidate chains can still reveal task information.
shadow_controls.start: Independent deterministic seed+500000; 50% shadow-first; later chain starts offset U(.2,1.5) after first chain ticket returns, matching the written draft control flow.

status: FINAL BEFORE FORMAL COLLECTION; freeze.json and remote readback are required

tests.C_cover_effect: 4 cover arms x 2: size_only_best(arm) minus size_only_best(none); exact McNemar, Holm. Descriptive of whether the cover still reduces recognition.
tests.E_primary_equivalence: Same six contrasts. Paired t-TOST +/-0.1 on fixture-level {-1,0,1} accuracy differences; df=119, max of one-sided p values; Holm across six. Finite-sample approximation. At all ties use boundary no-discordance probability .9^120, not p=0. Both models must pass to report tested attack-suite accuracy increment within the margin; not universal cover or role indistinguishability. Report discordant counts and power limitations.
tests.P_primary: gdm_live, concurrent, shadow x 2 models (6 tests): adaptive_best minus size_only_best, exact paired McNemar, Holm .05. An arm is 'separable' if in either model the difference is >= 12/120 with Holm p < .05.
tests.R_replication: unmatched x 2: label-free GMM strip minus size_only_best; replication holds if >= 24/120 with Holm p < .05 in both models.
tests.descriptive: Real-chain latency, union observation duration, extra model calls/tokens, unique connection bytes, true/shadow role error, chain partition fidelity (evaluation labels only), same honest path as none, task/state success, timing comparison. Timing errors and roles are not added to a new uncorrected superiority family. Real latency begins at admission before either shadow chain, so shadow-first waiting is included. Total connection bytes include TLS setup and teardown; no overlapping windows are double-counted.

timing_layers.L2: perf_counter_ns at relay completion of each encrypted TLS record (outer type 23). Connection initialization precedes call windows; outer type alone is not claimed to identify application plaintext. Each call window is nonoverlapping on its own connection; cross-connection overlap is allowed.
timing_layers.L3: Npcap captures both relay ingress legs. Independent TCP sequence reassembly reconstructs complete records, then matches types/lengths/counts and record-completion epoch times. Relay saves a simultaneous epoch/performance pair for each observed chunk.

uncertainty: 10,000 paired fixture bootstraps stratified by action, holding fitted attacks fixed; seed 1071111.
